message: Last summer, we had a surprise power outage during a heatwave. My kids were initially bummed about the lack of screens, but I quickly grabbed our flashlights and turned it into a mini adventure! We ended up playing flashlight tag and sharing stories by the glow of battery-powered lanterns. It reminded me how important it is to be ready for anything, even if it means swapping screen time for family fun. Have you ever turned a blackout into a bonding moment?
